findings.text: ETABS masses reproduce Dead+0.3Live only with g=9.80665 m/s^2; the project uses g=9.81. Masses rebuilt as weight/9.81 are 0.0341% lighter than the ETABS masses. Reconstruct from ETABS kg, or declare the g choice per comparison.
No exported table carries a time-history step series; ETABS-OpenSees NLTHA comparison is limited to Max/Min envelopes until step-by-step tables are exported.
Export holds events outside the 8-pair Soil-C set: Darfield, San Fernando, Tabas
Cases mix 'P-Delta' and 'P Delta'; always match case names literally.
All Ritz modes report zero RZ mass participation; torsion is absent from modal and response-spectrum results.
Export periods are rounded to 0.001 s; use CircFreq/Eigenvalue for comparisons.
Joint Design Reactions repeats Joint Reactions row for row; do not count it as a second source.
A combined lot repeats its split parts byte for byte; load one form only.

limitations: Workbook evidence only; native ETABS/OpenSees equivalence is NOT_VERIFIED.
Support tags follow an observed ordering rule; the OpenSees node map is not in the workbooks.
Time-history tables are Max/Min envelopes; no step series exists to compare.
